0022600089.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Grizzlies host the Utah Jazz, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Memphis a 45% chance to win. Isaiah Stewart is out with an ankle injury for Memphis, and GG Jackson, Jerami Grant (rest), and Micah Peavy are listed as day-to-day, with Jackson and Peavy dealing with ankle issues. For Utah, Jusuf Nurkic is out with a foot injury, while Blake Hinson (hip), Kyle Filipowski (back), and Trey Alexander (knee) are day-to-day, and the teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with the most recent meeting a 147-101 Utah win in Salt Lake City on April 10, 2026.
